description: List pending DM message requests (cold inbound from non-connections, which do not appear in dm_list until accepted). Returns Instagram's single requests page, which cannot be paged further. Read-only.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

name: dm_requests
title: DM requests
